messages:
Tara (AE): Prospect 'Studio' wants a compact 2-week POC. Scope = 3 micro-flows: intent routing, compact meeting summaries, tone-polish. Need: minimal prompt inventory, 100 golds/flow, quick eval script, headline cost, and security/keys path by EOD tomorrow. @Dev @Omar @Lea
Dev (SE): Copy. Hosted baseline; prepare a Dedicated fallback if they insist on customer-managed KMS. I'll draft 3 short prompts and include sample inputs.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Proposed acceptance gates: routing F1 >= 0.75, summary ROUGE-L >= 0.58, tone-accept >= 80% on a 150-sample blind check, p95 latency < 600ms. Mid-POC checkpoint day 6.
Lea (PM): I'll own runbook and checkpoints. Kickoff earliest Monday, 10 working days. I'll add sign-off steps and the escalation path to Dedicated/On-prem.
Dev (SE): Prompt inventory (compact, instrumented):
1) route_v1: "Return one label: [billing, setup, bug, feature, other]. Only the label."
2) summary_v1: "Summarize conversation in 3 bullets with actions first."
3) tone_v1: "Rewrite the reply: professional, concise, empathetic. Max 140 chars."
4) safety_v1: "If disallowed content, return 'BLOCK' and short reason; otherwise return 'OK' then the output."
Dev (SE): Each prompt will ship with 100 golden examples and an expected metric tag (accuracy/ROUGE/manual_agreement) and 20 spot-checks for hallucination.
Omar (Solutions Eng): Eval plan: 100 samples/flow to start. Command sample: `./eval/run.sh --suite studio_quick --n 100 --model redwood-hosted-v1`. Output: per-sample {id, flow, pred, gold, latency_ms, tokens_out, confidence}.
Tara (AE): Usage estimate from customer: avg 1.7 r/s, peak 9 r/s, ~300 tokens/req. Use for headline pricing sketch; finops will refine.
finops-bot: provisional_estimate: hosted_2w = $X (based on qps 1.7, peak 9, 300 tokens avg). Dedicated uplift approx +35% (placeholder). Include assumptions in final note.
sec-bot: security: hosted POC default retention 30d. Customer-managed KMS available on Dedicated. If customer requires control-plane isolation we must escalate to Legal + PS (2-4 week window).
Lea (PM): Action items: 1) SE (Dev) -> prompt JSON + 100 golds/flow (tomorrow AM). 2) Solutions Eng (Omar) -> eval harness + run guide + sample report. 3) AE (Tara) -> get customer sample data and confirm KMS ask. 4) Finops -> headline cost by tomorrow noon. 5) Security -> short answers for KMS, retention, and audit logs.
Dev (SE): Will keep prompts minimal and add instrumentation for token_count, latency_ms, and a confidence score. I'll upload prompts to POC folder and paste link.
Omar (Solutions Eng): I'll wire the harness to emit hallucination flags and a small CSV for debugging. Example parse: `jq '.results[] | {flow: .flow, metric: .score}' report.json`
ci-bot: canary: studio-eval-harness build 3.0.1 deployed to staging :white_check_mark:
Tara (AE): Thanks team. If we land artifacts tomorrow AM I can present scope + costs to the customer and lock dates. Keep this thread updated for any security or infra blockers.
Lea (PM): I'll create the POC checklist doc and drop the link here after upload. Closing for now.
